name: agent-skills-trial
description: Curated Claude Code workflows. Entries are the authority; the repo is a flat skills tree.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Issue to reviewed draft PR: a cold implementer builds it, an adversarial reviewer attacks it, GitHub carries the handoff

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Test-first at real seams: observe the failure, make it pass, then clean up. Refuses to write a test that cannot fail.

plugins.name: committing
plugins.description: Atomic commits with Conventional Commit messages: one commit does one thing, and the body says why rather than what.
